Anwar, 

 
 We call it the Dallas advantage.

 As one of the nation’s largest metropolitan areas, Dallas-Fort Worth is home to global leaders in technology, telecommunications, healthcare, and energy, including more than 20 Fortune 500 companies that have all hired UT Dallas alumni. Companies continue to move to DFW because of its exceptional talent pool, which includes graduates from nationally recognized research universities like UT Dallas.
